hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at a 2000 ms budget, an evolved score_ruin_nodes that anneals the rank power from ~1 toward ~2.5 as stagnation_ratio increases, multiplied by soft route-load (tight-capacity) and removal-size gates, will lower mean objective below the current SBS 16.0496 by >=0.5% by increasing ruin-set diversity exactly when the search stalls, with no increase in mean solve_ms above 400 ms.

next_search_advice.direction: Stagnation-adaptive multiplicative gating on the ruin score: score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings_i| * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand, p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio)) with p swinging low (1.0, near-greedy worst-removal) early and high (2.0-3.0, uniformized) as stagnation_ratio grows, plus soft gates that up-weight customers in nearly-full routes (tight capacity regime) and in spatially clustered groups (dense removal for clustered instances). This replaces last round's flat score (which regressed to 16.0711 vs SBS 16.0496) with explicit stagnation-driven diversification so LNS escapes local optima on the tight-capacity / size-100 / clustered weak regimes.
